name: Restaurant portion cost builder
why: Works out what one portion really costs, the number every offer and set menu is checked against.

name: Public review reply desk
why: Replies to each batch of public reviews, holds risky ones for the owner and flags repeat complaints.

name: Review reply batch writer
why: Writes a specific reply to each pasted review and lists the risky ones that need the owner.

name: Hotel channel revenue reconciler
why: Shows net room revenue by booking channel after commission, for the direct-versus-booking-site decision.

name: Hotel room and food contribution checker
why: Splits room and food contribution so a hotel package or dinner offer is priced on real numbers.

name: Prepare a hotel group booking handover
why: Checks deposits, rates and open requests on a group booking won by an event or wedding campaign.

name: Check a catering order before service
why: Checks a private-hire or catering order against the quote before the event the marketing sold.

name: Prepare a restaurant shift handover
why: Briefs the next shift lead on tonight's offer, event or allergen issues so the promise is kept.

name: Discount impact checker
why: Tests whether a planned discount can still hit the profit goal before it goes live.

name: Prepare a useful customer newsletter issue
why: A starting point for the monthly email to regulars, with a pre-send checklist.

name: Explain service booking terms to customers
why: Turns deposit, cancellation and private-hire terms into plain words guests understand.
